name: children[*].class_name
desc: Class name of the child object.

name: children[*].content
desc: Map of key-value pairs which represents the attributes of the child object.

name: children[*].rn
desc: The relative name of the child object.

name: class_name
desc: Which class object is being created. (Make sure there is no colon in the classname)

name: content
desc: Map of key-value pairs that need to be passed to the Model object as parameters.

name: delete
desc: Delete object during destroy operation. Default value is `true`.

name: device
desc: A device name from the provider configuration.

name: dn
desc: Distinguished name of object being managed including its relative name, e.g. sys/intf/phys-[eth1/1].
